question.question: What makes a normal move legal, can the same warriors move repeatedly, and do rivers count as paths?

expected.expected_answer: Move more than zero warriors/pawns along one linking path to an adjacent clearing; rule origin or destination or both. Same pieces can move repeatedly. Rivers are not paths unless explicitly treated as such.

source_passages.section: Actions — Shared movement, crafting and battle; Move (4.2)
source_passages.quotation: **Move (4.2):** Take any positive number of your warriors/pawns from one clearing along a linking path to an adjacent clearing. You must rule origin or destination or both. Recheck rule for each move. You may move the same pieces repeatedly, including on multiple moves in one action. Rivers are not paths unless an effect explicitly treats them as paths. Moving and placing are different procedures. Vagabond has its own movement exceptions below.

answer.ruling: Move a positive number of your warriors or pawns from one clearing to an adjacent clearing along a linking path. You must rule at least one endpoint, origin or destination, and rule is rechecked for each move.
